_note: the-decision-carries-the-brc-besluit-fields — two apps declared a `decision`, and a schema slug is global per organisation, so SchemaMapper::find() returned whichever row it reached first. They were not two copies of one record: this one is the governance decision (motions, voting, resolutions, amends/repeals/implements), and dossiq's was the VNG **Besluit** behind its BRC API — the standards-compliant Besluiten Registratie Component, wired into ZRC, WOO assessments and the bezwaar lifecycle. Folding them means this schema has to hold what the BRC serves. Five fields do that: deliveryDate, expiryDate, publicationDate, responsibleOrganisation and governingBody. The fifth was found by running the migration against a loaded instance: `governingBody` is the bestuursorgaan that TOOK the decision, and the only field here shaped like it, `targetBody`, is the body an appointment is made FOR and is a uuid. Mapping onto it would have been both a validation failure and the wrong meaning. `case` is deliberately NOT among them — cases and decisions are already linked, and adding a case reference here would be a second, competing link. dossiq keeps its BrcController; it serves from this register instead of its own.

Decision.description: A decision taken by a governance body, and the formal Besluit it produces. Carries the deliberation (how it was reached: motion, voting, adoption) and, since the-decision-carries-the-brc-besluit-fields, the four fields the VNG BRC serves that the governance model had no column for.

deliveryDate.title: Verzenddatum
deliveryDate.description: De datum waarop het besluit is verzonden aan de belanghebbende. BRC `verzenddatum`.
deliveryDate.description:en: The date the decision was sent to the interested party. BRC `verzenddatum`.

expiryDate.title: Vervaldatum
expiryDate.description: De datum waarop het besluit vervalt. Onderscheiden van `effectiveDate`, die zegt wanneer het ingaat. BRC `vervaldatum`.
expiryDate.description:en: The date the decision expires. Distinct from `effectiveDate`, which says when it takes effect. BRC `vervaldatum`.

publicationDate.title: Publicatiedatum
publicationDate.description: De datum waarop het besluit is gepubliceerd. Onderscheiden van `publishedAt`, dat het moment van publiceren in dit systeem vastlegt; dit is de datum die het besluit zelf draagt. BRC `publicatiedatum`.
publicationDate.description:en: The date the decision was published. Distinct from `publishedAt`, which records when this system published it; this is the date the decision itself carries. BRC `publicatiedatum`.

responsibleOrganisation.title: Verantwoordelijke organisatie
responsibleOrganisation.description: Het RSIN van de organisatie die verantwoordelijk is voor het besluit. Een RSIN en niet een `$ref`: de BRC identificeert de verantwoordelijke met dit nummer, en een verwijzing die alleen binnen deze instantie oplost zou het contract breken.
responsibleOrganisation.description:en: The RSIN of the organisation responsible for the decision. An RSIN rather than a `$ref`: the BRC identifies the responsible party by this number, and a reference that only resolves inside this instance would break the contract.

governingBody.title: Bestuursorgaan
governingBody.description: Het bestuursorgaan dat het besluit heeft genomen, bijvoorbeeld het college of de raad. Onderscheiden van `responsibleOrganisation`, dat de verantwoordelijke organisatie als RSIN vastlegt, en van `targetBody`, dat bij een benoeming het orgaan aanwijst waarvoor benoemd wordt. BRC `bestuursorgaan`.
governingBody.description:en: The governing body that took the decision, for example the executive or the council. Distinct from `responsibleOrganisation`, which records the responsible organisation as an RSIN, and from `targetBody`, which names the body an appointment is made for. BRC `bestuursorgaan`.
